paragraphs: Rabbi Abba bar bar Chana, who is Rabbah bar bar Chana (see there), Rabbi Yochanan’s student. It appears that his name was Abba (Rashbam likewise writes this, Bava Batra 75a), for he was told, “Every Abba is an ass, and every bar bar Chana a fool.” He sat before Rav Yehudah and went after Rabbi Elazar. He is not Rabbah bar bar Chana, Rabbi Chiyya’s nephew, for that one issued rulings in Rabbi’s time (see there), while this one sat before Rav Yehudah, and Rav Yehudah was born on the day Rabbi died. Yet this requires examination: it appears that the Rabbah bar bar Chana with Rav Yehudah is Rabbi Chiyya’s nephew, who descended to Babylonia, where Rav Yehudah also was. But Rabbah bar bar Chana, Rabbi Yochanan’s student, was in the Land of Israel; he told the stories of chapter Hassefinah to Rabbi Elazar, who was in the Land of Israel (see below, Ilfa).
